method_descriptions.projected_mean: projected paired mean; fixed-query score RMS matched
method_descriptions.raw_mean: raw paired mean; fixed-query score RMS matched
method_descriptions.random_direction: one random direction; score RMS matched, not final key-norm matched
method_descriptions.reversed_direction: negative projected mean; fixed-query score RMS matched
method_descriptions.label_shuffled: one source-group sign draw at the true-label-selected fixed head; no reselection
method_descriptions.direct_score_bias: constant signed bias on identical decision-query/key support

routing: oracle sign of target rule applicability
query_scope: first-answer query only; edit prefix cache before final prompt token
target_scope: one rule action span; all GQA queries sharing one KV head
matching: per-input per-direction fixed-query QK score RMS; zero or excessive-error responses blocked
calibration_evaluation_order: unit shifts once; all scaled shifts once in METHODS then supplied taus order; independent per-shift arithmetic
outcome_evaluation_order: METHODS then supplied taus order; one unchanged decision forward per completed nonzero condition
outcome: single-token A/B branch choice; not action execution
summary_policy: complete method/dose only; all blocked/missing coverage remains visible
paired_comparisons: matched triplet_id+variant vs zero baseline and same-dose direct bias
